email.label: Business Email
email.policy_notes: CAN-SPAM / GDPR / India DPDP compliant business inquiry. Requires explicit sender identity and one-line opt-out.
email.opt_out_template: Reply 'stop' or 'opt out' at any time and I will not follow up.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn Profile / Business Page
linkedin.policy_notes: No bulk automated InMail/connection scraping. Manual personalised outreach or approved API only.
linkedin.opt_out_template: No worries if not relevant—happy to never follow up if you prefer.

instagram.label: Instagram Creator Business Profile
instagram.policy_notes: No unauthorized DM automation. Short, contextual creator-first message referencing recent reel/episode.
instagram.opt_out_template: If this isn't useful right now, just let me know and I won't message again.

x.label: X (Twitter) Public Business Handle
x.policy_notes: Respect X automation rules; no unsolicited bulk DMs.
x.opt_out_template: Say the word if you'd rather not receive follow-ups.

website_contact.label: Creator Website Business Contact / Guest Pitch
website_contact.policy_notes: Manual submission via creator-owned business contact page or podcast guest/sponsor desk.
website_contact.opt_out_template: Please let me know if you prefer no further outreach.
